gaps.sentence: This is the second time the printer ___ down this week.
gaps.explanation: 'This is the second time …' is followed by the present perfect.

gaps.sentence: This is the best pizza I ___ in years.
gaps.hint: superlative experience counted up to now
gaps.explanation: Superlative statements about experience up to now take the present perfect: have eaten.

gaps.sentence: We ___ each other since primary school.
gaps.explanation: 'Since primary school' — present perfect of a state verb.

gaps.sentence: Water ___ at 100 degrees Celsius at sea level.
gaps.hint: a timeless scientific fact takes present simple
gaps.explanation: General truths and scientific facts take the present simple: boils.

gaps.sentence: When I got to the office, I realised I ___ my security pass.
gaps.hint: the forgetting happened before realising it
gaps.explanation: The forgetting happened before the past moment of realising, so the past perfect is needed: had forgotten.

gaps.sentence: When she was a student, she ___ spend her summers hitchhiking around Europe.
gaps.hint: a repeated past action with would
gaps.explanation: 'Would' describes repeated past actions in narrative: would spend.

gaps.sentence: He ___ the same bus to work every morning, even in winter.
gaps.hint: every morning signals a fixed routine
gaps.explanation: 'Every morning' describes a fixed routine, which takes the present simple: catches.

gaps.sentence: By the time you read this letter, I ___ the country.
gaps.explanation: An action completed before a future point takes the future perfect: will have left.
